Photorealistic character reference sheet: one wide image on a seamless plain light grey studio backdrop, showing the same single character nine times and nothing else.

The character. This brief only describes the character: none of its words appear in the image and any panel list in it is ignored:

Nine views on one continuous backdrop with no frames. The left third of the image holds four large head close-ups, two above two: the face from the front, the face in three-quarter view, the head in side profile facing right, and the back of the head. The upper pair fills the upper half of that third and the lower pair fills the lower half, so the four close-ups together span the full height of the image. Each shows the head and neck only, cropped below the neck in a clean straight line with no fading, and is about three and a half times as large as the heads of the full-body figures. The right two thirds hold five full-body figures standing in one evenly spaced row: front view, three-quarter front view, side profile facing right, three-quarter back view, back view.

The five full-body figures stand upright at exactly the same size and build, with their heads on one line and their feet on one floor line. An animal character stands upright like a person and keeps the head, fur, paws and tail of its species. Face, hair, age, build, outfit, accessories and every mark are exactly as the brief describes them and identical in every view. Nothing is added that the brief does not mention. Calm neutral expression, relaxed neutral pose.

A real studio photograph made as a film casting reference, 85 mm lens, soft even light, everything in sharp focus, true-to-life skin, hair and fabric, natural colours. No text, labels, numbers, borders, frames or watermark.
